description: Research and track Brazilian REITs (real estate investment funds, or FIIs) using natural language. Análise de FIIs organizes fund prices, dividend yield, fundamentals, indicators, risk, liquidity, distributions, and reports. Compare funds and use a screener to find FIIs that match your criteria. Authenticated Pro users can also track their own portfolios, including holdings, dividends, valuations, and processing status. The free preview provides public fund data and indicators, while Pro unlocks the remaining tools and full analyses. The app is informational and read-only: it does not buy or sell investments, move money, or replace financial advice.
